vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: compound-eng-file-todos
Version: 2.55.1

The skill provides a structured framework for file-based todo and task tracking using Markdown files within a dedicated directory. It utilizes standard shell utilities (ls, grep, awk, mv) for searching and managing task states and contains no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious code execution, or harmful prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it's an instruction-only, file-based todo workflow that only reads/writes markdown files in a todos/ directory and does not request credentials, installs, or external endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and included files (template, workflows, quick-reference) all align: the skill's purpose is managing markdown todo files under todos/. There are no unrelated environment variables, binaries, or config paths requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and examples are limited to file operations (cp, mv, ls, grep) and editing markdown frontmatter and worklogs. They do not ask the agent to read unrelated system files, network endpoints, or secret stores. Mentions of PR/gh integration are descriptive and optional; the skill does not require GH tokens or other credentials.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only. Nothing is downloaded or written to disk by an installer, so install risk is minimal.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. This is proportionate to its stated purpose of local file-based todo management.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and disable-model-invocation is true (the skill will not be autonomously invoked), so it does not get elevated persistent privileges. It does not modify other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears safe and coherent for managing todo markdown files. Before installing/use: (1) confirm you want todos stored in a local todos/ directory and that directory contains no sensitive info, (2) understand the quick-reference uses shell commands (grep, mv, ls) so the user or an invoked process will perform file operations, and (3) if you later integrate with GitHub (gh CLI) or other tools, those integrations will require credentials you must supply separately. Because the skill is instruction-only and model invocation is disabled, the risk surface is low. If you plan to enable automation or add external integrations, re-check required credentials and install steps at that time.
